title: CFDE Policies & Citation
bodyHtml:
Expectations For CFDE Knowledge Center Users

Authors citing the results of analyses performed using MATKP must cite: a) The CFDE Knowledge Center, b) all CFDE or non-CFDE programs that collected the donors, data, or analyses underlying each dataset and their funders, and c) the relevant publication(s) underlying the results accessed via the CFDE Knowledge Center (see “How to Cite” below). 

Agreeing to these provisions is a requirement of CFDE Knowledge Center use.

Re-using Site Content

Users are permitted to use figures and screenshots from the CFDE Knowledge Center in presentations and publications, with proper citation (see below).

User Tracking

The team tracks deidentified, aggregate analytics (such as hit counts for specific pages) to improve user experience. Individual user behavior is not tracked.

Resource Distribution and Sharing

To encourage data sharing and reproducibility, we are producing open-source methods and analysis workflows. We make these freely available for use by any other parties; the code is supplied “as is” with no implied warranty or promises of support. Code should not be reused for profit or harm.

How to Cite

Users who wish to cite the CFDE Knowledge Center in a scientific publication should do so in the following format:

The Common Fund Data Ecosystem Knowledge Center (https://www.cfdeknowledge.org), supported by NIH Office of the Director, Fund OT2OD036440. Year Month Date of access; URL of page cited. Specific identifiers/ accession numbers for datasets used.

Users citing donors, data and/or resources collected through other CFDE- or non-CFDE-generated studies should also cite all underlying studies comprising those datasets. All published datasets must be cited according to the associated publication, using DOIs and PMIDs when available. Data reused from third-party repositories must adhere to their citation policies.
